data.description: Two non-blocking findings from the AS-2 QA review (qa-priya): (1) store.markRead accepts an upTo watermark beyond the current max message id — should clamp or reject; (2) CLI 'chat history @identity' and 'chat read @identity' get-or-create the DM conversation row on what should be a pure read. Neither violates any AS-2 acceptance criterion; both are small correctness/hygiene fixes in apps/chat/lib/store.js and apps/chat/bin/chat.js.
data.title: Chat app: tighten markRead bounds + make CLI reads side-effect-free

data.body: Planning pass done (cto-owen). Verified against current master: BOTH original qa-priya findings still real. (1) markRead accepts upTo > max message id — poisons the watermark irreversibly via the MAX() upsert; only reachable caller-supplied surface is POST /api/read. Decision D1: REJECT (StoreError, in-tx), not clamp — over-max upTo is always a caller bug since message ids are insert-only monotonic. (2) resolveConv still openDm-creates DM rows on history/read/reply @refs (the createDm flag is dead code); since AS-5 this is also an export-churn bug (phantom dm-*.jsonl), and since AS-8 dmConversationFor is the ready-made pure lookup. NOT real: no CLI command mutates read_state as a side effect — inbox/history are already non-mutating; read/catchup mutate explicitly (that IS delivery). D2 records delivery semantics as status quo, binding. Export invisibility of read_state confirmed (export.test.js:80). Plan: .lattice/plans/task_01M185QACGZFPZ50Z7TV6SBR3P.md. Baseline suite 85/85 (needs NODE_OPTIONS=--no-warnings on node 24 — 2 stderr-strict tests else trip on the node:sqlite ExperimentalWarning; environmental, pre-existing, out of scope, watch for recurrence).

Implementation done (developer-marcus), commit 3995576 on feat/AS-3-read-hygiene. store.markRead: bounds check moved inside the BEGIN IMMEDIATE tx, over-max upTo throws StoreError naming the current max (D1 reject-not-clamp); /api/read gets the 400 for free. bin/chat.js: resolveConv @refs now pure via dmConversationFor (requireIdentity first, self-DM check keeps openDm's wording); history/read/reply handle 'no DM yet' per D3; dead createDm flag deleted. Suite 91/91 green with NODE_OPTIONS=--no-warnings; without it, only the 2 known pre-existing stderr-strict env failures (ExperimentalWarning, per plan section 3). Boring choice worth flagging for review: plan left 'chat read @x --json' no-op shape unspecified — I emit {"conversation": null, "lastReadId": null}, mirroring markRead's return keys. Reply wording chosen: "No DM with @x yet — message @x#N does not exist." Test count landed at 91 (plan estimated ~93): the plan's five cli bullets are grouped into three tests.

REVIEW (qa-priya, cold, 2026-08-30, feat/AS-3-read-hygiene @ 3995576): PASS — recommend done, no rework, no inline fixes needed. Walked all 7 plan criteria; commands recorded here. [AC1 PASS] over-max upTo rejected in-tx: probed boundaries on a scratch store — empty conv (max=0): upTo=0 accepted lastReadId=0, upTo=1 throws StoreError; upTo==max accepted; max+1 throws naming the bound ('Invalid upTo N: last message id in conversation C is M'); unreadCountFor unchanged after rejection. tx() verified to propagate the callback's return, so the return-from-inside-tx refactor is shape-identical. [AC2 PASS] non-integer/negative still rejected with old wording; null->max; below-watermark no-op via MAX() upsert all reprobed green. [AC3 PASS] purity proven against a COPY of the live DB with direct sqlite counts, not exit codes: conversations|members|read_state|messages|SUM(last_read_id) = 9|11|31|111|1008 before AND after history(text+json)/read(text+json)/reply on a never-DM'd pair (qa-priya<->ceo-carla); exit codes 0/0/1 per D3; bogus --me still fails via requireMe before resolveConv, zero rows. [AC4 PASS] grep: openDm callers are exactly bin/chat.js:166 (chat dm) and server.js:105 (POST /api/dms). [AC5 PASS] no-phantom-export test green; purity makes phantom dm-*.jsonl structurally impossible. [AC6 PASS] suite run in-container myself (compose test service, mountless): 91 tests, 91 pass, 0 fail. [AC7 PASS] server.js/schema/UI untouched (diff --name-only). HIDDEN-CHANNEL GATE ORDER (my hostile case): requireVisible fires BEFORE the tx bound check — non-member markRead(hiddenConv, 999999) returns unknown_conversation with the byte-same 'Unknown conversation X.' template as a nonexistent id (never the bound error, which names conv id + max); member of the same private channel DOES reach the bound check; DM non-member still gets forbidden pre-bound. AS-6 parity holds; the bound message's id leak is post-gate only, no action. D2 delivery semantics reverified on the copy DB: inbox mutates nothing (read_state sum unchanged), read/catchup still mark (catchup advanced 3->111, 5->79, created row for conv 8 at 0). Implementer's 3 recorded choices: (1) read @x --json {conversation:null,lastReadId:null} — sound, mirrors markRead's keys; (2) reply wording 'No DM with @x yet — message @x#N does not exist.' — sound, exit 1, names both facts; (3) 91 vs plan's ~93 — fine, all five cli.test bullets are present, grouped into three tests (verified each assertion exists). No findings in either category (criterion violations: 0; backlog wishes: 0).
